config.purpose: Test whether a general adaptive recency rule improves migration calibration without age-specific overrides.

formula.informationStrength: mean annual events / (mean annual events + priorAnnualEvents)

method.inflow: Blend long and recent annual event means.
method.outflow: Blend long and recent exposure-weighted hazards; convert to diagnostic event counts using target-year exposure only to isolate calibration quality.

baseline.description: Locked component-flow windows already selected before external holdout results.

knownCohortCase.note: Descriptive only; this cohort motivated the diagnostic and must not be used to tune the rule.

config.governance: Do not activate in production based on the known 1999 cohort. Require broad improvement across origins/ages and no material degradation in independent/external validation.

county.label: Övriga länskommuner
county.rationale: 6 years had the lowest n+1 MAE for both inflow and outflow in Lulea; n+2 remained competitive.

rest_sweden.label: Övriga Sverige
rest_sweden.rationale: 10 years minimized n+1 inflow MAE; 4 years marginally minimized n+1 outflow MAE.

international.label: Utlandet
international.rationale: 10 years minimized international inflow MAE at n+1 and n+2; 2 years clearly minimized emigration MAE at both horizons.

methodNote: Outflow diagnostic uses observed target-year exposure only to isolate hazard calibration; it is not a full forecast score.

knownCohort1999.note: Descriptive only; this cohort motivated the diagnostic and must not be used to tune the rule.
